name: Divine Heart Karen
original_name: ディバインハート・カレン
source: Divine Heart Karen is another form of Narukami Karen who induces genesis power and transforms. She can move around freely like a butterfly and consecutively attack with twin blades, Ark Edge, and dual guns, Ark Shooter, like a storm. Each time she falls, she will learn various things such as techniques or tactics. She is the strongest protector of Reclis City and a transformed heroine.
